findings.current: He had seen it clearly: Officer Gwak, who was in charge of Dongting Lake, had been fawning over these people and addressing them with honorifics.
findings.defect: “Fawning” adds deliberate sycophancy. The source says Officer Gwak was visibly flustered and struggling while speaking deferentially, demonstrating the passengers’ status without assigning him an ingratiating motive.
findings.rationale: 쩔쩔매며 describes being flustered or at a loss, not flattering someone for favor.
findings.replacement: He had seen it clearly: Officer Gwak, who was in charge of Dongting Lake, had been visibly flustered as he addressed these people with honorifics.
findings.source: 똑똑히 봤다. 동정호를 책임지고 있는 곽 군관이 쩔쩔매며 존댓말을 사용하는 모습을.

findings.current: That was when Cheongpung’s voice rang out again.
findings.defect: The draft invents another utterance from Cheongpung immediately before Jin Taekyung emerges from the water. No voice or speech occurs here in the source.
findings.rationale: The source only marks the moment when the subsequent splash and landing occur.
findings.source: 그렇게 늙은 사공이 아무도 모르게 신령을 향한 기도를 올리고 있던 그때였다.

findings.current: A beautiful silver hairpin held his strangely well-matched, disheveled hair in place.
findings.defect: The modifier is attached to the hair, making the disheveled hair “well-matched.” In the source, the silver hairpin is what suits him strangely well.
findings.rationale: 묘하게 잘 어울리는 describes the hairpin’s unexpectedly fitting appearance.
findings.replacement: A beautiful silver hairpin that suited him strangely well held his disheveled hair in place.
findings.source: 그리고 묘하게 잘 어울리는, 헝클어진 머리를 고정한 아름다운 은비녀.

findings.defect: The casual contraction removes Hyuk Mujin’s deferential register toward his superior.
findings.rationale: 오셨습니까 uses honorific and formal-deferential speech; the replacement preserves respectful distance without adding an address absent from the source.

findings.current: “Did you find anything this time, too?”
findings.defect: The question reverses the implied result. The boatman is cautiously asking whether this search also yielded nothing, as confirmed by the immediately following explanation of Taekyung’s dark expression.
findings.rationale: 이번에도 elliptically refers to another unsuccessful search, not another discovery.

findings.current: “If we continue at the pace we’ve kept so far, about fifteen minutes should be enough. But…”
findings.defect: The draft halves the stated travel time. 한 식경 is approximately the time required to eat a meal, conventionally about thirty minutes, not fifteen.
findings.rationale: The source specifies one sikgyeong; fifteen minutes corresponds more closely to one gak.
findings.replacement: “If we continue at the pace we’ve kept so far, about half an hour should be enough. But…”
findings.source: “지금까지 왔던 방식으로 간다면 한 식경 정도면 충분합니다. 한데…….”

findings.current: At Hyuk Mujin’s weighty voice, the boatman slowly turned the ferryboat around.
findings.defect: “Turned the ferryboat around” states that he reversed direction. The source only says he began changing or setting its course toward the final destination.
findings.rationale: 배의 방향을 틀다 means to change the boat’s direction and does not specify a 180-degree reversal.
findings.replacement: At Hyuk Mujin’s weighty voice, the boatman slowly began adjusting the ferryboat’s course.
findings.source: 혁무진의 묵직한 음성에 사공은 천천히 배의 방향을 틀기 시작했다.

findings.current: Deep enough that no one would want to enter it.
findings.defect: The draft generalizes Mungyeong’s personal reluctance into a claim about everyone, losing the characterization that even this exceptionally capable master does not want to enter the water.
findings.rationale: The omitted subject is Mungyeong, whose internal viewpoint continues directly into his resigned thought that he has no choice.
findings.replacement: Deep enough that even he had no desire to enter it.

findings.defect: “Old fool” invents a judgment about the disciple’s intelligence and converts the mildly chiding, familiar 이 녀석아 into a harsher insult.
findings.rationale: 이 녀석아 is a familiar rebuke or affectionate scolding; the disciple’s age comes from the preceding narration and is not part of this address.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter actions, quantity, hierarchy, viewpoint, or characterization.
